_comment: The map base: a hole in hell's ground, one ring deck round the void the tower stands in, with a lava river cut into it. Authored in WORLD coordinates -- instance at identity: deck at y=23.0 (r 46.7..57.3) under a rock ceiling at y=31.5 (the gallery is a cutout, open toward the void), lava sea at y=-11.05, rim at y=330. The river is NOT a sheet laid on anything: between bearings 292.3 and 338.3 the deck's own surface is dropped 0.3 m to y=22.7 between two sloped banks, and those faces take the LavaRiver material. The channel carries on into both walls the same way -- cut 0.4 m back into the shaft wall from 293 to 338 deg, y 22.7 up to 30.7, and 0.4 m back into the pit wall all the way down to the sea -- so the lava is always map_base's own faces, defined by banks, never an overlay. Seven platforms with flat square 2.4 x 2.4 m tops at y=23.0 stand 0.3 m out of it; three fins rise off the inner ones. Prison cells (arched glowing recesses with carved columns) are carved into the pit faces, visual only, and none in the channel. THREE surfaces: the hell-rock atlas (rock + emissive), LavaSea -- the pit floor, on its own seamless emissive sheet -- and LavaRiver, on a tiling sheet streaked along the flow. All single-sided. Four cross-lane walls stand in the gallery -- the section dividers at 76, 206 and 291.5 deg and the big one at the start at 13 deg -- each a closed mass of this same rock from 0.8 m under the deck to 0.3 m inside the ceiling, spanning r 46.8..58.3 with one mouth cut through at the lane and a tangential spur where its foot grips the pit lip. MapBaseCollision is the purpose-built collider shipped as a `-colonly` node (deck minus the channel, a flat surface at the lava height minus the platform footprints, the platform tops and sides, the fins, pit wall, courtyard disc, outer wall, flat ceiling); Godot turns it into a StaticBody3D + ConcavePolygonShape3D and drops its mesh, so `surfaces` counts only what is drawn. S3, the demon minefield, is bearings 143..202 of the deck re-laid on its own 0.4 m grid from one height field (tools/modelling/lib/s3_minefield.py): a field of plain deck under a scatter of demon_pad scene nodes, a pad-free corridor cut through it, low rock crests grown out of the deck for cover (tops 1.9..2.1 m, flanks over 46 deg), and three dips where the floor drops ~0.55 m under a pad that has to be jumped. No lava and no TrapVolume in it.
